name: Implicit Surface Field Function Evaluation
definition: A volume described by a field function d = f(x,y,z), where d represents density/distance. Points inside have d < 0, outside have d > 0, and on the contour d = 0.
summary: Implicit Surface Field Function Evaluation computes the signed distance value for a 3D point to determine its position relative to a surface, distinguishing itself by focusing on single-point mathematical evaluation rather than batched inference or binary classification.
